args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, and the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy with error rate back down to 0.002.
